paste_insert_phase.description: Diagnostic insertion phase for a 128 MiB mixed UTF-8 paste, excluding fixture setup and metadata refresh.

paste_metadata_phase.description: Diagnostic synchronous metadata-refresh phase after a 128 MiB mixed UTF-8 paste.
